name: Duthorian Rall
summary: In Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall guides new holy warriors through their trials. The respected human knight of the Silver Hand is one of the Alliance's most influential paladins, overseeing their training and spiritual tests. He teaches charity, valor, and devotion as they prepare to defend Azeroth from the Scourge and threats within the kingdom.

sections.title: A Pillar of the Silver Hand
sections.body: In the Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall upholds the traditions of the Knights of the Silver Hand. The kingdom is unsettled by internal strife, and King Varian Wrynn is missing. Duthorian carries the duty of teaching discipline to new initiates. Respected paladins in the field send promising recruits to him: Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge, so they can begin their sacred trials.

sections.title: Trials of Compassion and Life
sections.body: Duthorian teaches that martial power without a moral foundation is hollow. In the Tome of Divinity trials, he tests an initiate's empathy through acts of mercy and selfless service across Stormwind. Only after these tests does he entrust candidates with deeper mysteries. Near Heroes' Vigil, he tests them with the Symbol of Life, then sends them to aid wounded allies and learn to channel the Light's power to restore fallen comrades from death.

sections.title: The Price of Valor
sections.body: Duthorian's trials of valor demand courage in the face of peril. He warns aspirants that their vows may cost them their lives. To test their resolve, he sends initiates into danger, including to defend Daphne Stilwell from Defias renegades in Westfall. He then directs them to master smith Jordan Stilwell outside Ironforge and grants them holy steeds worthy of their station.

faq.answer: Duthorian Rall is a prominent knight of the Silver Hand who resides in Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light. He instructs and guides new paladins, testing their devotion and courage in service to the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Where can Duthorian Rall be found?
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall can be found in the eastern wing of the Cathedral of Light, at the heart of Stormwind City's Cathedral Square.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Tome of Divinity?
faq.answer: Duthorian gives paladins the Book of Divinity and guides them through trials of humility, compassion, and rescue. Completing the trials proves an initiate worthy to wield the Light's power to resurrect the dead.

faq.q: Why does Duthorian send paladins to Westfall?
faq.answer: Duthorian sends paladins to protect Daphne Stilwell from Defias bandits on her farm in Westfall during the Tome of Valor trial. The danger tests their willingness to sacrifice themselves to defend the innocent.

faq.q: What rewards does Duthorian grant to paladins who pass his trials?
aliases: what do you get from duthorian
faq.answer: Through Duthorian's guidance, successful paladins earn key holy capabilities, including the sacred gift of resurrection, the ability to sense undead, protective armaments such as the Bastion of Stormwind, and eventually a summoned warhorse.

faq.q: Who sends adventurers to Duthorian initially?
faq.answer: Paladin trainers, including Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge, typically direct aspirants to Duthorian.

angles.text: As a paladin, you receive Duthorian Rall's guidance in Stormwind. His foundational trials test your compassion and valor, unlocking resurrection, divine senses, and your warhorse.
As an Alliance defender, you rely on Duthorian, an influential Silver Hand leader, to keep the Alliance's defenders morally upright and able to defend the realm against bandits and undead.
As a human, you find Duthorian anchored in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, where he represents the devotion and chivalric discipline central to human faith and society.
